opening.argument: The segment presents ordinary ways to obtain Target gift cards through shopping, promotions, trade-in activity, and exchanging unwanted cards. It explains that viewers may earn cards by shopping at Target, finding promotions tied to certain purchases, selling unused electronics through Target, or exchanging unwanted gift cards. The visual slides likewise identify exchanging unwanted gift cards and checking the gift-card trade-in website. Although the presentation uses the phrase “FREE TARGET GIFT CARDS,” the described participation remains connected to ordinary commerce and exchange options. Nothing in the supplied material indicates deceptive instructions, fees, or other scam mechanisms.
